content.comment_body: Hello, I have an [article_no] base module but only [product_name] Comfort V2.0 available. I tried upgrading online to V5.0, but I can't connect my PC to the [product_name] through COM1. The error message says (translated from French): Please verify: - [product_name] is in the correct mode - The PC cable is properly connected - The correct interface is selected Try again? YES NO Select interface... HELP When I choose 'Select interface...', I pick COM1 and 'Automatic Detection'. An error pops up: Interface selection failed! Please check: - [product_name] mode: PC - If the PC cable is linking the [product_name] and PC OK I'm using cable [article_no] and a controller [article_no]. Would appreciate any help! Thanks, [user_name]

Please double-check these aspects on both your PC and [product_name]: On your device: - Ensure the module is powered on. - The transfer cable connects the [product_name] to the PC. - The display should show 'LOGO PC'. On your PC: - Close any programs using the COM port, such as synchronization tools, printers, or other communication programs. - Review your port settings by navigating to Tools > Options > Interface > Automatic Detection. - Set the FIFO buffer in System Information > Hardware Manager > COM Ports to the lowest value (send and receive = 1). These steps might help resolve the connection issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The main challenge is a connection failure between the user's PC and a [product_name] device, involving a certain cable and software version. Error dialogs focus on interface selection and cable verification, while the troubleshooting actions given are mostly manual checks of hardware connections and COM port settings. System messages lack straightforward, actionable steps for resolving the connection issue, and there's additional complexity from using older base hardware with newer software.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipates seamless connection between the PC and [product_name] via COM1 using [product_name] software, expecting either clearer guidance or automatic detection to address configuration problems.
